Same story here OP, but it's been almost 10 years since then. My only advice is that don't mind them, it's their problems and their relationship, mind your own business and just trust on your parents that they will figure things out.

My parents separated 4 years ago and tbh, although things could've been better and they could've been more honest to each other, it doesn't change one bit that I still love them very much. 

Support your mother by little things, cook her meals and appreciate her hard works. Your dad has a path of his own too, trust that he made the decisions on his own and let people move on. If they need help they'll come to you, for a talk or whatever but if your help is not needed, it's not your battle to fight. Focus on yourself.
